essence: The mantra designated as terrible is defined by being eighteen-syllabled.
A mantra endowed with hṛllekhā, hook, and seed is declared destroyed when it is in that ruined condition.
Mantras are designated young at sixteen syllables and mature at forty letters.
A four-hundred-syllabled mantra is classified as old.
A mantra devoid of śiva and śakti syllables is called seedless.
